_about: LIN-4505: the pre-cutover Waiting series, read once from git and committed as data. The Waiting lists were the area notes' `## Waiting` sections; LIN-4495 retired them and LIN-4505 imported them as records. One entry per first-parent commit: a number is the count of bullets under `## Waiting` across the notes directory (a commit with no notes directory reads 0); a string is the reason the commit has no count. The stability tool (scripts/stability-measures.mjs) reads a window's endpoints here, by commit (keys are the first 12 characters of the sha), and never reads the lists from git. A commit not in the series is `not measured`, never 0.

commits.81b5901834a7: the area notes carry no ## Waiting section at this commit (the lists were retired in LIN-4495)

runner.through: first-parent commit on origin/main at or before

records.note: The first record the LIN-4505 import wrote (its `at`). The records store dates imported records at import, so a commit before this has no records reading. From here, waiting.harbour reads the open hand-offs to the project (findings and questions) as of the commit's time, through GET /api/proxy/records.
